diseases.name: Acute viral hepatitis
diseases.inv: LFTs, hepatitis A/E IgM, HBsAg, anti-HCV, INR.

diseases.name: Alcohol-related liver disease
diseases.alt: Viral hepatitis, drug-induced injury, other chronic liver disease

diseases.name: Biliary obstruction / cholangitis
diseases.inv: Ultrasound abdomen, LFTs, blood cultures; urgent senior review if unwell.

diseases.name: Pancreatic or biliary malignancy
diseases.inv: Ultrasound/CT abdomen, tumour markers per specialist.

diseases.name: Haemolytic jaundice
diseases.inv: CBC, reticulocyte count, peripheral smear, indirect bilirubin, LDH.

diseases.name: Drug-induced liver injury
diseases.inv: LFTs; review all drugs, herbal remedies and supplements.

diseases.name: Peptic ulcer disease
diseases.inv: Urgent endoscopy; H. pylori testing; check haemoglobin.

diseases.name: Variceal bleeding
diseases.inv: Emergency resuscitation and endoscopy; coagulation and liver tests.

diseases.name: Oesophageal cancer
diseases.inv: Urgent upper GI endoscopy and biopsy.

diseases.name: Candida oesophagitis
diseases.inv: Endoscopy; HIV test and glucose check.
diseases.alt: Reflux oesophagitis, pill oesophagitis, viral oesophagitis

diseases.name: Intestinal obstruction
diseases.inv: Urgent surgical review; abdominal X-ray, CT; fluids and electrolytes.

flags.text: Vomiting blood or black stools: assess haemodynamics urgently
Haematemesis or melaena: possible upper GI bleed, check pulse and blood pressure
Black stools: possible upper GI bleed, check pulse and blood pressure
No stool or gas with vomiting and distension: possible intestinal obstruction, urgent surgical review
Jaundice with fever and right upper abdominal pain: possible cholangitis, urgent assessment
